summary: Enterprise CMS foundation validated end-to-end. Backend: 22/22 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_enterprise_cms.py pass covering (1) AUTH: super_admin login+role, forgot-password idempotent for existing & non-existing emails, reset-password 400 on invalid token and on <8 char password; (2) RBAC: /api/admin/users 401 without cookie, 200 for super_admin, 403 for editor role (persisted editor.test@tasned.sa via API and cleaned up), create+update+delete of users; (3) CMS: unknown type -> 404, public GET returns only published & non-future items, admin GET returns all, PUT creates a cms_versions snapshot, list versions>=1, restore adds another version, DELETE works, scheduled future published_at hidden then visible after moved to past; (4) MEDIA: 401 without auth; PNG upload returns url starting /api/media/files/, mime=image/webp (auto-convert), width/height=10, GET url returns 200 image, PUT updates alt/caption/folder, DELETE works; (5) AUDIT: /api/admin/audit returns entries with user_email/action/resource/ip/ts; (6) SETTINGS: public GET returns object, PUT ga4_measurement_id+canonical_base persists and is visible on public GET; (7) SEO: /api/sitemap.xml is application/xml with <urlset>, /services and news slugs; /api/robots.txt has 'User-agent: *', 'Disallow: /admin/', 'Sitemap:'; (8) Regression: /api/news list, /api/contact submit, /api/careers with PDF still return success. Frontend (Playwright, live REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL): admin login with admin@tasned.sa/12a34b56cd21 redirects to /admin; sidebar renders all 14 items (Dashboard, Homepage, Services, Team, Clients, Testimonials, FAQs, News, Media Library, Contact Requests, Careers, Site Settings, Users, Audit Log). Services CMS full flow: New Service -> f-title_en 'E2E Service' + icon 'Droplets' + status Published -> cms-save creates cms-row-0 -> cms-del-0 removes row (toast 'Deleted'). Media Library upload via input[data-testid='media-upload'] adds a new card. Site Settings: filled s-ga4_measurement_id='G-TESTING123' and clicked settings-save -> success toast. Public / then reloaded — <script id='ga4-src'> was injected into <head>. Hero H1 contains 'Trusted Ballast Water Testing for Ships' (visual line break between 'Water' and 'Testing'). Nav has 'Careers' and no /admin link. /admin/forgot-password submits and shows 'Check your email' screen. Cleaned up: editor test user, all TEST_ CMS items, uploaded media (tiny.png/tiny2.png), and reset site settings (ga4_measurement_id/canonical_base cleared).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 799 lines with 8+ resource areas (auth, news, contact, careers, users, cms, media, settings, seo). Consider splitting into routers/ modules by domain before further growth.
Media DELETE endpoint restricted to super_admin/admin — editor role cannot delete their own uploads. Confirm this is desired RBAC.

audit() writes are best-effort but not wrapped in try/except; a mongo write failure during audit would surface as a 500 to the caller of a successful mutation. Consider fire-and-forget with error logging.
sitemap.xml has no caching header — every request re-reads settings + news. Cheap now, but add Cache-Control at scale.
MediaLibrary UI has no data-testid on the per-card Delete button (only title='Delete'). Adding e.g. data-testid={`media-del-${i}`} would improve testability.
Password reset link uses os.environ.get('FRONTEND_URL','') — if unset, link becomes '/admin/reset-password?...' which would 404. Env var IS set here, but validate at startup.
GA4 injection reads settings on every mount of Layout — works, but a small in-memory cache with TTL would reduce load.
test_credentials: admin@tasned.sa / 12a34b56cd21 (super_admin) — verified. Editor role verified via ephemeral editor.test@tasned.sa (created + cleaned up).
seed_data_creation: All test data cleaned up: editor.test@tasned.sa user, TEST_ CMS service items, tiny.png/tiny2.png media assets, and site_settings ga4_measurement_id/canonical_base reset to empty strings. TEST_ contact/careers rows may remain in their collections (no admin delete endpoints exposed) — inert log data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two backend test files now: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (original — auth+news+contact+careers) and /app/backend/tests/test_enterprise_cms.py (new — RBAC, CMS versions/scheduling, media, settings, audit, SEO, regression). Both are pytest-discoverable and independent — safe to run together. All existing seeds (super_admin user) are preserved and idempotent via startup hook. Note: the sitemap includes /services and news slugs, and settings.canonical_base overrides FRONTEND_URL for both sitemap and robots.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found; all listed features work as specified.
